_comment: First-party Applied Energistics 2 compat (AE2PLAN #18d) — the FINITE certus deposit (ae2:quartz_block; deconstructs → 4 certus crystals) on the deepslate-bodied ancient mining island; complements the rocky family. The gate ingredient the meteorite-island seed recipe consumes, NOT a functional AE2 supply (certus alone builds no storage — that needs the meteorite island's sky stone + inscriber presses). Modern AE2 has no certus ore; the inert quartz_block is the deposit block. Inert without AE2 (unknown block skipped before RNG → byte-identical). Bands merge into ancient's max_y:20 / min_y:96 bands (selectors match ancient.json) so certus doesn't vanish on low/high throws, per immersiveengineering_ancient.json. Base-density counts. Mirror to appliedenergistics2_ancient_large.json + appliedenergistics2_huge_ancient.json.
